newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Dromex to seek bourse listing in two yrs.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Dromex to seek bourse listing in two yrs.

text.p: Polish state-owned construction company Dromex SA plans to seek a bourse listing in about two years after a strategic investor buys a stake in a current tender, the company was quoted as saying on Thursday.

"We will first find a strategic investor....We do not know what plans the future investor will have and how many shares will be kept by the treasury, and that is why we're thinking about the bourse in a two-year perspective," the Parkiet economic daily quoted financial director Jaroslaw Piechotka as saying.
Piechotka was quoted as saying that an investor, likely to be chosen by the end of March, was needed to strengthen Dromex so that it could participate in Poland's motorway construction programme.
Earlier this week the treasury ministry invited bids for between 10 and 80 percent of shares in Dromex. Bids are due until January 17.

Dromex, which specialises in infrastructure projects such as roads and bridges, is part of the Autostrady SA consortium that is seeking to build a 364-kilometre motorway between the central city of Lodz and the German border.
